articles.title: Take-Two Appears to Be Trying to Scrub GTA 6 PC Ports From the Internet, as Vibecoders Race Toward Controversial World First
articles.summary: Take-Two appears to be taking on the many GTA 6 PC ports currently in the works following Cyberleek’s alleged release of an unauthorized Xbox build of the game.
body: This week, Cyberleek allegedly released the executable file for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build they reportedly leaked the week prior, sparking a race within the homebrew scene to port the build to PC. There’s even a website tracking the various attempts to recompile, emulate, or port the leaked Xbox Series build to PC.
But it looks like Take-Two is taking action, reportedly convincing GitHub to delete an entire network of 3,007 repositories via a DMCA takedown notice.

Additionally, there’s an interesting note in the takedown order that addresses the “bring your own files” defence we’ve seen so often from the homebrew community when it comes to unofficial ports of video games. As you’d expect, Take-Two isn’t in favor of it, insisting that in this case, the files the user must provide come from the unauthorized GTA 6 Xbox build Cyberleek leaked online.

According to now deleted social media posts, NotRexed, author of the Leonida project, shut it down entirely. There are also screenshots of its Discord showing users posting disclaimers distancing themselves from Project Leonida in case of a federal investigation.
points: Take-Two appears to be taking on the many GTA 6 PC ports currently in the works following Cyberleek’s alleged release of an unauthorized Xbox build of the game.

articles.title: Raul Bautista Actor Manny Perez Bought a PS5 So He Could Play GTA 6
articles.summary: The actor behind one of the best GTA characters of all time has started working his way through GTA 6. Manny Perez, who plays Raul Bautista, bought a PS5 just so he could play. “Guy, I’m playing and this s**t is crazy!” he said in a video posted to social media. “Look how real that looks.
body: According to Perez, the biggest issue as a non-gamer has been getting used to the DualSense controller, which he called “the stick,” but he’s “getting there.”
The actor sent a follow-up tweet after a fan shared the video. “Will take a while but I will finish this game,” he said. “Thank you all for the support. I’m loving the comments and appreciations.”

Raul Batista is a big character in GTA 6 from Chapter 3 onwards, and one of the highlights of the game in terms of performance. Batista steals the show in some really cool scenes, which I won’t spoil, but I can see him becoming a fan favorite as people work their way through the story.

Perez isn't the only GTA 6 actor who's started to talk about their work on the game and fan reaction to their character. For example, Lexie Shoaibi has spoken out about her "bittersweet" newfound fame after her character, Mandy, went viral online. And Issa Lopez, who plays a radio host on GTA 6’s fictional Cocoteo FM radio station, described the wild non-disclosure agreement she had to sign before working on the game, calling the project “crazy secretive.”

articles.title: Please, GTA 6, Give Us More of Jason’s Favorite Gay Romantasy Series
articles.summary: Jason Duval is a pretty quiet guy, as far as Grand Theft Auto protagonists go, but there's more to this character than meets the eye, including his love of books. In GTA 6, players will find several books scattered around Jason and Lucia's home in Key Lento, such as Ashes of Glory, Lethal by…
body: Thankfully, Jason actually carries it around and reads it at the beach, giving players the chance to sneak a look at it. As it turns out, The Battle for Zantoroth is the second book in the in-game King of Gorgollia romantasy series. Hey, who's to say that a hardened criminal can't enjoy a romantasy book? It's a popular genre for a reason.

The blurb on the back cover gives us a good idea of the plot of the book. The Battle for Zantoroth is about Austin Livingstone, a man who works in a tavern, who is sent by the king on a harsh journey out to sea alongside Jonathan "Sticky Broom" Ritchey, a sailor and tavern regular. As the two embark on the voyage, they come across a plethora of dangers and challenges that ultimately bring them closer. Eventually, the lines between friendship and lust become blurred. They come to learn that they are not just lovers, but actually... father and son. At this point, they have gone too far, and it is too late to turn back.

articles.title: GTA 6 Analysis Shows PS5 Version Suffers 'Substantially' More Frequent Frame Rate Drops Than Xbox Series X Version
articles.summary: The tech experts at Digital Foundry have revealed their analysis of GTA 6, and found the game performs “meaningfully better” on Xbox Series X than the base PS5.
body: Sony’s high-profile marketing deal for GTA 6 involved the key phrase, “Plays Best on PS5,” and while that marketing tagline encompasses more than just performance, many are now questioning its validity with GTA 6 out in the wild.

Digital Foundry found that Xbox Series X provides a “virtually identical visual presentation” to the PS5 in terms of overall image clarity and presentation quality, but there is a significant split on performance.

As Rockstar had announced before launch, GTA 6 “targets” 30 frames per second across all platforms, from the Xbox Series S up to the PS5 Pro, but there are moments where the frame rate drops. According to DF’s analysis, the frame rate suffers more on PS5 than Series X.

articles.title: Tangles Review
articles.summary: Tangles Review: The Gay Nineties collide with a high-strung Jewish family in a shattering animated film about dementia.
body: Tangles is in theaters in New York and Los Angeles on Nov. 27. It will expand to a wider release in January.

The weight of memory is vital to the biographical animated feature Tangles, a black-and-white story about family, the queer ‘90s, and above all else, early-onset Alzheimer’s. Based on the sparse but powerful 2012 comic by Sarah Leavitt — who co-wrote the screenplay with Trev Renney and director Leah Nelson — the film employs abstractions in its margins and connective tissue, making room for straightforward drama that proves incredibly moving in its unearthing of lived experience.

They blame it, at first, on menopause, and then on Midge losing her job and her ensuing depression, but minor tasks prove frustrating and confusing for the usually gentle 50-something, who’s drawn with appropriately haggard squiggles. It takes a while before a real diagnosis tells them what might be wrong: an early form of dementia. This forces Sarah to fly back and forth between her family and her supportive, stud girlfriend Donimo (Samira Wiley), a schism of time, place and culture that slowly wears on her as Midge’s disease advances.
points: Tangles Review: The Gay Nineties collide with a high-strung Jewish family in a shattering animated film about dementia.

articles.title: CD Projekt Red signs new marketing partnership deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and to increase "the presence" of its games on PlayStation
articles.summary: As part of The Witcher and Cyberpunk studio CD Projekt Red's recent Q3 earnings report, the developer offered some updates on upcoming game The Witcher 4.
body: During an earnings call yesterday, the studio revealed it had signed a new partnership deal with Sony regarding marketing rights to The Witcher 4, as well as to extend "the presence" of CD Projekt Red's other games across the PlayStation Store and PlayStation Plus.

"Just today, we signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign," said studio CFO Piotr Nielubowicz. "This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years."

Nielubowicz didn't elaborate on what exactly that means for The Witcher 4's marketing, but perhaps it could enable Sony to advertise the action-RPG as a PlayStation game, similar to the Grand Theft Auto 6 'plays best on PlayStation' campaign. But seeing as The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release, we may not find out what form that agreement takes for some time.

articles.title: 24 Years Later, Star Trek's Most Controversial Movie Is Officially Free on Streaming
articles.summary: Saying goodbye to beloved television characters is never easy. After spending years getting to know them, audiences have expectations about how their stories should end. Some get the send offs they deserve, while others leave fans wondering what might have been.
body: The fourth and final film featuring the Next Generation cast finds Captain Jean-Luc Picard ( Patrick Stewart ) confronting Shinzon (Tom Hardy), a younger clone of Picard who has seized power in a Romulan coup and plans to destroy Earth with a devastating weapon. It's a promising premise that Nemesis squanders on a convoluted, action-heavy story that forgets what made these characters special.

Now streaming free on Pluto TV, Nemesis remains a disappointing conclusion to the Next Generation film series. Having revisited it recently, I can confirm that nearly 24 years haven't done much to improve it.

The best episodes of The Next Generation aren't necessarily the ones featuring massive space battles. "The Measure of a Man" explores Data's humanity, while "Darmok" focuses on two captains struggling to communicate. Neither requires Picard to jump behind the wheel of a dune buggy and race across an alien desert while shooting at the locals. Yet that's exactly what Nemesis gives us.
points: Saying goodbye to beloved television characters is never easy.
After spending years getting to know them, audiences have expectations about how their stories should end.
Now streaming free on Pluto TV, Nemesis remains a disappointing conclusion to the Next Generation film series.
Having revisited it recently, I can confirm that nearly 24 years haven't done much to improve it.

articles.title: Rust Will Officially Introduce Premium Paid Service With a Most-Requested Feature
articles.summary: In August, Facepunch removed the controversial Battle Pass system entry from this year's Rust roadmap. It was replaced with Rust Premium, a status that grants players who have at least $15 worth of items in their inventory access to premium servers, but not much else.
body: Rust Premium is now available on the staging branch, the build that allows Rust players to test upcoming features before they go live. Within the Rust Premium menu, we can see which perks will be available to Premium users; among them is character customization — a feature that fans have been eagerly awaiting since the player model update.

This feature was scheduled for 2026 Q4, meaning it's likely coming in the next force wipe. Rust fans can therefore expect Rust Premium and character customization to become available on Thursday, Dec. 3, when the monthly update drops.

After digging through the staging branch files, user Protox believes that once players customize their character, they won't be able to change it for the rest of the wipe. So, they'd be stuck with it for a whole month. This makes sense as a way to prevent players from changing their appearances mid-wipe to unfairly deceive others in-game.

Reaching this milestone after five years of development means a lot to our entire team. With core game content now complete, we're dedicating our full focus to polishing and optimizing the experience so that when you step into Showa American Story, it feels cohesive, responsive, and complete."

articles.title: Wizards of the Coast's War Against MTG Proxies Isn't as Bad as It Sounds
articles.summary: Wizards of the Coast, a Hasbro subsidiary and the publisher of popular tabletop games Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons, has filed a massive lawsuit against a provider of proxy Magic cards, PrintMTG Enterprise, seeking more than $28.6 million in damages.
body: Proxies are replicas of Magic cards printed to resemble real items. Although they are not allowed in official tournaments, proxies are still somewhat popular in casual play, especially within the Commander format. Notably, Premodern, a format that includes cards from 1995 to 2003 and is steadily growing in popularity, allows proxy cards in some tournaments.

However, while some Magic players are already concerned about a possible visit from the Pinkertons, things aren't as bad as they seem. Wizards is not suing PrintMTG Enterprise for producing proxy Magic cards, but for marketing their products as proxies "to lend them a veneer of legitimacy while actually plying a business built around the sale of counterfeit cards," the lawsuit reads. The distinction is important: "An honest proxy is a stand-in for a real card that makes no claims to authenticity, by appearance or otherwise." On the other hand, "A counterfeit is made to be mistaken for the real card and to take its place as something owned, traded, or sold."
points: Wizards of the Coast, a Hasbro subsidiary and the publisher of popular tabletop games Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons, has filed a massive lawsuit against a provider of proxy Magic cards…

articles.title: Capcom's sci-fi dinosaur shooter Exoprimal is shutting down next year
articles.summary: Sad news dinosaur lovers. Exoprimal - Capcom's third-person sci-fi shooter with a Jurassic twist - will be shutting down next year. With its closure, the game will no longer be playable, even for those who've got it downloaded.
body: In a new post to the official Exoprimal website, it's revealed the game will be shuttered on 29th September 2027, at 8am PDT across all regions. Until then, all Survival Passes (battle pass equivalents) are no longer available for purchase, with the game and all its DLC stripped from stores on 30th March.

If you do fancy hopping in for a bit to send off Exoprimal in style, you'll still be able to re-download the game after it's taken off stores if you originally downloaded the game in the past. Tragically, the game will no longer be playable at all once shuttered, as there's no offline support. As an always-online game that requires a constant internet connection, it'll be one for the history books, at least in an official capacity.

articles.title: Performance analysis reveals GTA 6 has a more stable frame-rate on Xbox Series X compared to PlayStation 5
articles.summary: If you don't own a PlayStation 5 Pro, the best way to play Grand Theft Auto 6 is reportedly on Xbox Series X. That's according to new performance analysis, which shows Microsoft's console is more consistent at maintaining the game's 30fps frame-rate target than the base PS5.
body: The findings come from the tech experts Digital Foundry, who published a big report covering all the technical similarities and differences between Sony and Microsoft's consoles.

Unsurprisingly, PS5 Pro is in the lead with no competition, as Xbox elected not to release a mid-generation upgrade for the Series console family. Sony's more powerful console delivers "the definitive console GTA 6 experience," according to Digital Foundry. The PS5 Pro has the most stable 30fps performance of all four consoles, and benefits from a sharper presentation at 4K thanks to Sony's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) image upscaler, which upscales the image from a 1440p base resolution.

It's when comparing the base consoles - Xbox Series X and PS5 - that things get a little more interesting. Both target a 30fps frame-rate and often maintain that target, but certain sections trigger drops. According to the report, those include sequences with busy crowds and fast vehicle traversal. In some cases, the drops can be as low as mid-to-high 20fps.
points: If you don't own a PlayStation 5 Pro, the best way to play Grand Theft Auto 6 is reportedly on Xbox Series X.
That's according to new performance analysis, which shows Microsoft's console is more consistent at maintaining the game's 30fps frame-rate target than the base PS5.

articles.title: GTA 6's best lore drops happen when you're chilling with your partner, so stop leaving them at home all the time
articles.summary: My real relationship be damned, this last week has been all about playing cupid in Grand Theft Auto 6. I've become utterly invested in keeping Jason and Lucia in love, which means a lot of my time in the game has been spent doing things with my partner in tow.
body: And, as people tend to do when they're spending a lot of time together, Jason and Lucia talk. A lot. And you know what? Some of the best nuggets of information about their lives—both their time spent together before the events of the game, and their own individual lives before meeting one another—are tucked away in these interactions that fill the game's quieter moments.

Sometimes the interactions are simply fluffy, or funny. Lucia poking fun at Jason for his deep voice and monosyllabic responses, or them reminiscing about little moments that happened in their relationship before the whole "Lucia ghosting Jason and ending up in jail" thing. Sometimes it's Lucia getting a spam call and giving the bot (and eventual human) on the other end of the phone an absolute earful.

articles.title: Call Of Duty’s 19-Year Sales Streak Continues
articles.summary: Circana has released its latest monthly sales report for the US video game industry, and in terms of game sales, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 led the way. It was the No.
body: It was the No. 1 best-selling game of October 2026, and that's notable because it marked the 19th consecutive year that a new Call of Duty game has been the top-selling title for its launch month.
This streak began in November 2008 when Call of Duty: World at War beat out Guitar Hero: World Tour and Gears of War 2 to rank No. 1.

Circana also announced that spending on content for consoles dropped by 18% compared to October 2026. It was always going to be a tough comparison, though, as October 2025 saw the releases of Battlefield 6 and Pokemon Legends Z-A.

Looking ahead to November 2026, Rockstar's GTA 6 is no doubt going to rank No. 1 for the month and it's sure to finish 2026 as the best-selling game overall. It's already selling at a blistering pace, after all.

articles.title: Inside Retro Reset, the "really inspirational" father and son project teaching kids about classic games hardware from aboard a converted bus
articles.summary: At first the kids jostle to get to the games that they know. "Welcome to the Retro Reset Bus," says Luke Stoner as the students push to get to the screen that’s caught their eye.
body: The event is being run by East Sussex Careers Hub and is specifically aimed at students with SEND (Special Educational Needs and Disabilities). More than twenty-five schools turn up and most teachers leave with a flyer, chatting to colleagues about where the bus could park onsite. Jason says that the response to the bus, since Retro Reset's launch as a registered charity in August 2025, has been phenomenal, and they could easily fill a full week with visits. For now, he is juggling it with work commitments.

The bus was Luke’s idea and inspired by a visit to The Centre for Computing History in Cambridge, where visitors can get their hands on home computers and consoles from decades gone by. The family started thinking about what was possible and finally, after Luke finished college, began kitting out the bus: buying or accepting donations of hardware, researching which monitors would work with the ancient systems, and installing it all within the cabin.
